[Sir](../persons.html#2382)
My only [paper](../books.html#268) in [Atalanta](../others.html#53) is on the Life of [Mr Keble](../persons.html#798).

Those on Novel writing are by Mr [Walter Besant](../persons.html#1652)[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to \'C T Hiatt Esq/ Sandon/ Wellington/ Salop\' and postmarked 1889.

[^2]: This was an autograph hunter\'s trick to get a signature, see Martin Ray, \'Thomas Hardy\'s Letter to Charles Hiatt\' Notes and Queries 53 (2006), 338.
